waivers.reason: Held only as Shapefile and MapInfo sources. Identities are read from the Shapefile attribute table, but no compiler reads Shapefile geometry yet.

Great Britain areas are served, reprojected from British National Grid, but Northern Ireland areas are not. Reprojected the same way, they land at least 50 m from the ONS's own WGS84 release of the same boundaries (median 65 m across the 11 district councils and 64 m across 410 wards), a shift no standard transformation explains. Use a WGS84 release for Northern Ireland areas.
The publisher lookup names N06000004 Belfast West in three rows and Belfast North in one. Both names are kept as labels rather than the Atlas correcting the source.
